title: First-touch capacity cheat-sheet & SLA strip (visual assets + screenshots)
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a compact, first-touch visual asset set for Dedicated onboarding targeted at quick decision-making: 1) Capacity Cheat-Sheet card (one-line guidance on instance families, estimated QPS/latency per GPU profile, cost ballpark, and recommended starting reserve sizes); 2) SLA Strip (a horizontal comparison showing Reserved vs Autoscale behavior: expected p50/p95 latencies, cold-start penalty, and availability SLOs); 3) Stepper microflow screens (annotated screenshots for the console stepper with microcopy for each step); 4) Two screenshot variants for dark/light themes; 5) Export-ready PNG/SVG assets and a small set of copy snippets for docs and onboarding emails. Emphasis on scannable info hierarchy, single-glance tradeoffs, and clear CTA to "Estimate capacity" and "Request reserved trial". Deliverables will be uploaded to Figma, added to the console screenshot suite, and referenced in the onboarding PRD.
